zh.title: 菲律賓航空接收第四架空中巴士A350-1000客機
zh.summary: 菲律賓航空第四架A350-1000客機抵達馬尼拉；機隊擴增計畫持續推進
body: 菲律賓航空（Philippine Airlines）已正式接收其第四架空中巴士（Airbus）A350-1000長程客機。這架國籍標誌暨登記號碼為RP-C3513的新機，在完成從法國土魯斯空中巴士生產設施的交機飛行後，於2026年9月2日當地時間19:22降落於馬尼拉的尼諾伊亞奎諾國際機場（MNL）。
本次交付的RP-C3513客機，是菲律賓航空於2023年訂購的9架A350-1000客機中的第四架，屬於該公司機隊現代化與國際營運擴展策略的核心部分。菲律賓航空目前仍是東南亞地區首家且唯一營運空中巴士A350-1000機型的航空公司。
作為菲律賓航空長程航線的旗艦機型，該架A350-1000採用三艙等配置，共設有382個座位。商務艙配備具有滑動隱私門的獨立包廂，同時設有專屬的豪華經濟艙與升級的經濟艙產品。目前該機型已投入營運舊金山、紐約及多倫多等主要國際長程航線。
除了已運作的現役機隊外，菲律賓航空亦持續進行未來的機隊佈局。在2026年6月舉行的范保羅國際航空展期間，該航空公司簽署了瞭解備忘錄，擬增購9架空中巴士A350-1000客機（並附帶5架額外購買權），以及15架波音（Boeing）787-10廣體客機（附帶5架選購權）。相關合約預計交機期將持續至2036年。
菲律賓航空擁有APEX四星級航空認證，並於2025年獲評為亞太地區準點率最高的航空公司。此外，該航空公司已於2026年獲得正式邀請，準備加入寰宇一家（oneworld）航空聯盟，進一步拓展其全球航線網路。

en.title: Philippine Airlines Takes Delivery of Fourth Airbus A350-1000
en.summary: Philippine Airlines receives its fourth Airbus A350-1000 aircraft in Manila as fleet expansion continues.
body: Philippine Airlines has taken delivery of its fourth Airbus A350-1000 long-haul aircraft. The widebody jetliner, registered RP-C3513, touched down at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL) in Manila at 19:22 local time on September 2, 2026, following a delivery flight from Airbus' manufacturing facility in Toulouse, France.

The aircraft is the fourth of nine A350-1000s ordered by Philippine Airlines in 2023 as part of its ongoing fleet modernization and international route growth strategy. Philippine Airlines remains the first and sole air carrier in Southeast Asia to operate the Airbus A350-1000 variant.

Serving as the flag carrier's flagship for long-haul intercontinental routes, the A350-1000 features a 382-seat cabin arranged in a three-class layout. The onboard product includes business class suites with sliding privacy doors, alongside dedicated premium economy and enhanced economy class passenger cabins. The aircraft type is currently deployed on key transpacific and international long-haul routes including San Francisco, New York, and Toronto.

The delivery forms part of a broader fleet expansion framework for Philippine Airlines. During the Farnborough International Airshow in June 2026, the carrier signed Memoranda of Understanding for nine additional Airbus A350-1000 aircraft with purchase rights for five more, as well as 15 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliners with options for an additional five aircraft. Deliveries under these expansion commitments are expected to run through 2036.

Philippine Airlines holds APEX Four Star airline status and was recognized by Cirium for achieving the highest on-time performance among Asia-Pacific carriers in 2025. In 2026, the carrier received an official invitation to join the oneworld global airline alliance, strengthening its global partnership network.

zh.title: 美國正式對進口無人機開徵最高100%關稅
zh.summary: 美國正式對進口無人機課徵最高達100%關稅；盟國產品可申請關稅上限優惠。
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，美國於2026年9月3日東部時間凌晨12時1分起，正式對進口無人機及關鍵零組件徵收最高達100%的關稅。此項措施依據美國總統川普於同年8月13日簽署的第11055號公告執行。最大起飛重量超過25公斤的無人機系統將面臨100%的關稅，而25公斤以下的較小型無人機關稅則為25%。
來自日本、南韓、台灣、瑞士、列支敦斯登或歐盟成員國等盟國的產品，在進口商證明關鍵零組件實質源自合格經濟體的前提下，可申請最高15%的關稅上限。此外，名列五角大廈 Blue UAS 清單或聯邦通信委員會（FCC）條件批准清單的企業，其產品關稅將延後至2027年2月9日實施。

en.title: US Tariffs of Up to 100% on Imported Drones Take Effect
en.summary: US begins imposing tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones starting September 3, 2026.
body: According to AeroTime, the United States began imposing tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and critical components at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on September 3, 2026. Under Proclamation 11055, signed by President Donald Trump on August 13, 2026, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) with a maximum takeoff weight above 25 kilograms are subject to a 100% tariff. Smaller drones weighing 25 kilograms or less face a 25% tariff.

Products originating in allied nations, including Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, or European Union member states, can qualify for a capped tariff of 15% if critical components and technology originate in eligible economies. Additionally, products from suppliers on the Pentagon's Blue UAS lists or the FCC's Conditional Approval List as of September 2, 2026, will have their tariff implementation delayed until February 9, 2027.

zh.title: 美國航空首架改裝Flagship套房波音777客機首航布宜諾斯艾利斯
zh.summary: 美國航空首架改裝Flagship套房波音777客機執飛紐約至布宜諾斯艾利斯。
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）公佈首架改裝Flagship套房（Flagship Suites）的波音777-300ER客機，該機於2026年9月2日執飛紐約（JFK）前往布宜諾斯艾利斯（EZE）的航班，正式投入商業服務。
本次改裝移除頭等艙，將原本8個頭等艙與52個舊型商務艙座位替換為70個Flagship套房，特選經濟艙座位亦由28個增加至44個。美航計畫對旗下20架波音777-300ER機隊進行改裝。
隨著Flagship套房推出，舊型頭等艙預計於2026年11月19日起停止提供預訂。該改裝機型未來亦將營運東京（NRT）、聖保羅（GRU）與雪梨（SYD）等長途航線。

en.title: American Airlines Unveils First Retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER
en.summary: American Airlines launched its first retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER featuring Flagship Suites on a flight to Buenos Aires.
body: American Airlines has unveiled its first Boeing 777-300ER retrofitted with its new Flagship Suites. The upgraded widebody aircraft officially entered commercial service on September 2, 2026, operating a flight from New York (JFK) to Buenos Aires (EZE).

The retrofit eliminates First Class on the Boeing 777-300ER fleet, replacing eight first-class and 52 legacy business-class seats with 70 new-generation Flagship Suites. The cabin reconfiguration also expands Premium Economy capacity from 28 to 44 seats across the carrier's 20 B777-300ER aircraft.

Following the deployment of Flagship Suites, legacy First class bookings will end on November 19, 2026. American Airlines also plans to operate the retrofitted aircraft on long-haul routes connecting the United States to Tokyo (NRT), Sao Paulo (GRU), and Sydney (SYD).

zh.title: 行政院追加1457億元國防預算納入無人機採購
zh.summary: 行政院通過追加預算，編列559億元採購濱海監偵與攻擊型無人機。
body: 台灣行政院於2026年9月3日通過了中華民國115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案，其中國防部追加預算共編列新台幣1457億元。該預算主要用於提升防衛作戰能力的武器購製，以及因國軍招募人力成長所增編的戰鬥部隊加給等需求。
根據主計總處資料，在國防追加預算的1457億元中，包含濱海監偵型無人機等3項無人系統項目共計559億元。此外，預算案還編列了中層反戰術彈道飛彈系統等7項共130億元、2項機密計畫共645億元、急缺彈藥補充73億元，以及台灣戰術網路跨網域情資整合案9億元。另有25億元用於因應招募人力成長的薪資預算，以及16億元用於增加戰鬥部隊加給。
國防部戰略規劃司長黃文啓在院會後記者會說明，由於無人機部隊已於去年陸續成編並在今年1月定位，目前主要缺乏無人載具裝備。國防部預計於今年啟動濱海監偵型、濱海攻擊型無人機及自殺無人艇的先期採購作業。預計在116年（2027年）開始建置使用單位的初始戰力，並期盼在2027年底前讓相關單位達到基本戰備存量的要求。
黃文啓指出，無人載具追加預算具有指標性意義，預期能為國內業者提供足夠信心，並挹注非紅供應鏈中的關鍵導航、飛行控制等晶片項目，以落實本土產能建置。此外，急缺彈藥補充預算則旨在將戰備庫存從30天逐步提升至120天，並補充因演訓頻率增加而消耗的彈藥。
國防部補充說明，原先「強化防衛韌性及不對稱戰力計畫採購特別條例」上限為1.25兆元並包含23個項目，但部分項目先前未獲通過。因此，本次追加預算案中，已將過去未獲全數通過的13項委製、商購及台美共同研發採購的武器裝備項目全部納入。一旦預算經立法院審議通過，國防部將加速招決標及武器裝備籌獲，以縮小因時間延宕產生的戰力缺口。

en.title: Taiwan Approves NT$145.7 Billion Defense Budget Supplement Including UAV Procurement
en.summary: Taiwan's Executive Yuan approves defense supplementary budget on September 3 to procure military UAVs.
body: Taiwan's Executive Yuan on September 3, 2026, approved a central government supplementary budget, allocating NT$145.7 billion for national defense. The funding is intended to procure weapons to enhance defense combat capabilities and support combat troop allowances amid growth in military recruitment.

According to the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, the NT$145.7 billion defense allocation includes NT$55.9 billion for three unmanned system programs, such as coastal surveillance unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Additionally, NT$13.0 billion is designated for seven items including mid-tier anti-tactical ballistic missile systems, NT$64.5 billion for two classified programs, NT$7.3 billion for urgent ammunition replenishment, and NT$900 million for a cross-domain tactical network integration project.

Huang Wen-chi, Director of the Strategic Planning Department of the Ministry of National Defense, explained that while UAV units were formed last year and positioned by January this year, they currently lack unmanned systems. The ministry plans to launch procurement for coastal surveillance UAVs, coastal attack UAVs, and suicide unmanned surface vessels this year, with initial combat capabilities scheduled for establishment in 2027 to meet basic combat stock requirements.

Huang noted that the NT$55.9 billion UAV budget carries symbolic significance, offering confidence to local industry players while channeling resources into key chips for navigation and flight control within "non-red" supply chains. Regarding ammunition, the NT$7.3 billion replenishment will gradually raise combat stock levels from 30 days to 120 days to cover resources consumed by increased military exercises.

The defense ministry noted that the supplementary budget incorporates 13 previously unapproved programs from a larger NT$1.25 trillion special purchase statute, which originally comprised 23 items. These remaining projects consist of domestic production, commercial military purchases, and joint Taiwan-U.S. research and development. Following legislative approval, the ministry aims to accelerate bidding, contract awards, and equipment acquisition to mitigate combat capability gaps.

zh.title: 中探針連接器切入無人機領域 預計2027年展現貢獻
zh.summary: 中探針連接器切入無人機；研發微機電探針；預期2027年帶來貢獻。
body: 中探針總經理馮明欽於2026年9月3日在SEMICON Taiwan展覽上表示，公司連接器產品已成功切入無人機以及人工智慧（AI）智慧眼鏡等應用領域。同時，中探針正與半導體大廠共同研發微機電探針（MEMS）與清針紙等新產品，相關項目正按進度推進，預計至2027年將產生實質業務貢獻。
在業務結構方面，中探針說明目前連接器業務約占總營收6成多，半導體相關業務則占約25個百分點。隨著新產品導入，公司設定目標至2027年將半導體業務營收占比提升至3成。

en.title: CCP Contact Probes Expands Connectors into Drones and Develops MEMS Probes for 2027 Growth
en.summary: CCP Contact Probes expands connectors into drones; develops MEMS probes; targets 2027 operational contributions.
body: At SEMICON Taiwan on September 3, 2026, CCP Contact Probes General Manager Feng Ming-chin announced that the company's connector products have entered applications for drones and artificial intelligence smart glasses. The company is also jointly developing micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS) probes and clean sheets with major semiconductor manufacturers. These development projects are progressing as scheduled and are expected to make substantial operational contributions by 2027.

Regarding current revenue composition, CCP Contact Probes stated that connector products account for over 60 percent of total revenue, while semiconductor-related business represents approximately 25 percent. Driven by new product introductions, the company aims to increase the revenue share of its semiconductor business segment to 30 percent by 2027.

zh.title: 日本消防廳首度訂購空中巴士H160直升機將部署熊本
zh.summary: 日本總務省消防廳訂購首架空中巴士H160直升機，將部署於熊本縣以強化防災救援。
body: 日本總務省消防廳於2026年9月3日與空中巴士簽署合約，首度訂購一架下一代空中巴士H160直升機。該架直升機將部署於九州地區的熊本縣，加入該廳現有的直升機隊，以提升全國性的緊急應變速度與覆蓋範圍。
該直升機的主要任務是在重大自然災害期間，進行快速空中偵察與即時影像情資蒐集。該機將配備先進的 Helisat 衛星技術，可直接將高畫質數據傳輸至衛星，繞過受損的地面基礎設施。此外，空中巴士也正在為該機型開發專用的雪地著陸起落架，以應對日本嚴冬的深雪作業。

en.title: Japan's Fire and Disaster Management Agency Orders First Airbus H160 Helicopter
en.summary: Japan's FDMA ordered its first Airbus H160 helicopter to enhance disaster response in Kumamoto.
body: On September 3, 2026, Japan's Fire and Disaster Management Agency (FDMA) signed an order for its first Airbus H160 helicopter. Stationed in Kumamoto prefecture within the Kyushu region, the helicopter will join the FDMA's existing fleet to enhance nationwide emergency response capabilities and coverage.

The H160 will be utilized for rapid aerial reconnaissance and real-time visual intelligence gathering during major natural disasters. It will feature Helisat satellite technology to stream high-definition data directly to satellites, bypassing damaged ground infrastructure. Airbus is also developing custom snow landing gear for deep-snow operations.

facts.claim: 日本總務省消防廳簽署合約首度訂購空中巴士H160直升機，將部署於熊本縣。
facts.sourceQuote: Japan’s Fire and Disaster Management Agency (FDMA), under the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, has signed an order for an Airbus H160, marking the agency’s very first acquisition of the next-generation helicopter.

facts.claim: 該直升機將搭載 Helisat 衛星技術以在重大災害期間進行空中偵察與影像蒐集。
facts.sourceQuote: the H160 will feature Helisat advanced satellite technology. By streaming high-definition data directly to orbiting satellites, the system completely bypasses damaged ground infrastructure

facts.claim: 空中巴士正為該直升機開發專用的雪地著陸起落架以因應日本嚴酷的冬季氣候。
facts.sourceQuote: Airbus is developing custom snow landing gear designed specifically for the H160, ensuring uncompromising safety and stability during deep-snow operations in Japan’s severe winter climates.

organizations: Japan's Fire and Disaster Management Agency
